default.description: Default capabilities for the Freed desktop app

fb-login.description: Allows the Facebook login window to report session completion

fb-scraper.description: Allows the hidden Facebook WebView to emit events back to the app

ig-scraper.description: Allows the hidden Instagram WebView to emit events back to the app

li-scraper.description: Allows the hidden LinkedIn WebView to emit events back to the app

main-logging.description: Write local main-window diagnostics through the native logger without granting access to provider pages or login windows.

medium-session.description: Allows the hidden Medium WebView to emit capture results to Freed

substack-session.description: Allows the hidden Substack WebView to emit capture results to Freed

youtube-session.description: Allows the authenticated YouTube session to emit capture results to Freed
